alignment_reasoning: The image demonstrates exceptional class conformance. The complex geometry of the coiled tubing and rotary valves is structurally sound and biologically/physically plausible. The mix of nickel-silver and brass finishes is consistent with high-end instruments. Only the occluded mouthpiece prevents a perfect 5.0 score, as its presence cannot be visually verified.
artifact_reasoning: The image is free of major structural defects like melting limbs or fused boundaries (confirmed by Topology Auditor mask confidence 0.989).
